parameters.query: CALL sp_set_photo($1, $2); SELECT u.id, u.phone, u.name, DATE_FORMAT(u.birthdate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS birthdate, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birthdate, CURDATE()) AS age, u.gender, u.jersey_name, u.jersey_number, u.jersey_size, u.photo_key, u.profile_complete, DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS member_since, (u.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 20 SECOND) AS is_new, COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('sport', s.sport, 'role', s.role, 'batting_hand', s.batting_hand, 'bowling_style', s.bowling_style, 'rank', s.`rank`)) FROM app_user_sports s WHERE s.user_id = u.id), JSON_ARRAY()) AS sports FROM app_users u WHERE u.phone = $3
